verdict.rationale: Rippling exposes a developer platform with APIs, extensions, a CLI (rippling-cli) and a sandbox for building custom apps, showing broad programmatic access exists, but there is no evidence claiming or demonstrating full feature parity between the API and the UI (e.g., payroll runs, benefits enrollment, or time-and-attendance actions shown in the UI are not confirmed as API-accessible). missing for 10: explicit parity claims or documentation mapping UI actions to API endpoints, independent verification that all UI workflows are scriptable via API.
